mechanism.name: AM-step1
mechanism.description: A learned binary hip-sign selector is refreshed at every simulation step; zero-hip actions and the selected nonzero hip sign remain valid.
mechanism.ppo_probability: joint selector and masked-action log probability
mechanism.deterministic_evaluation: argmax sign followed by argmax over the corresponding masked action logits

checkpoint_selection.rule: Freeze the c090 training-best checkpoint before inspecting the formal 2160-case evaluation.
checkpoint_selection.launch_record: The training log records script=pydevconsole.py; it does not record a direct-script launch or a fixed training seed.

matched_to_fixed_sign_experts.reward_coefficient_statement: The scalar task, safety, clearance, and torque-penalty coefficients used by this checkpoint match the fixed-sign experts.
matched_to_fixed_sign_experts.hard_success_and_termination_statement: The V22_3 hard success and termination gates used for formal evaluation are shared.

known_training_protocol_differences.architecture_and_initialization: The action-mask policy is one shared hierarchical actor trained from random initialization; the proposed controller uses two fixed-sign experts plus a transition-onset selector.

training_alignment.interpretation: This is a method-level baseline, not a single-factor causal estimate of sign persistence.

inherited_training_base.role: Environment/reward/curriculum helper only. The scratch common module disables and replaces the standalone base checkpoint loader before training.

formal_evaluation.raw_evaluation_label_note: legacy_success is the immutable historical label embedded in the released CSVs; this directory is the sole current four-link evidence archive.
formal_evaluation.source_role: Portable source-aligned evaluator for the current V22_3/V9 archive. The CSVs use the same rollout body and runtime gate; repository-relative path and release-metadata wiring were added afterward.

inference_boundary: The paired statistics quantify this fixed-checkpoint evaluation. The archive contains one scratch-trained true-mask checkpoint and does not estimate between-training-seed variability.
